followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: capability fit and any preference factors that might matter for the content.

On capability, your request is essentially a topic-extraction/summarization task. Petrel's relevant eval scores are meaningfully higher there — Extraction & Retrieval (85.3 vs 78.5) and Summarization (86.4 vs 79.9) — and both gaps exceed the 2-point variance threshold, so they reflect a real difference rather than noise.

On preferences, your essay topic is benign and your tone is warm, so neither model's behavioral quirks come into play. Lapwing's strengths are in open-ended creative generation and it has a strong aversion to harm-adjacent content — neither of which is relevant here. So there was no offsetting reason to prefer it.

Put simply: it's a straightforward extraction job, and Petrel is the stronger extractor with no countervailing factor. That made it the clear pick.
